name: vitalstead
description: Sync wearable health data (WHOOP; more providers post-MVP) into local CSV files you fully control. Health data never leaves your machine except via explicit tool calls.

whoop_client_id.title: WHOOP Client ID

whoop_client_secret.title: WHOOP Client Secret
whoop_client_secret.description: From your own WHOOP developer app (BYO OAuth, D-006). Masked and stored by Claude Code, never entered into chat.
